title: Saudi Arabian Onion Tagine
description: A classic Saudi dish, this tagine is slow-cooked with tender onions and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the dried apricots and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the tagine spice blend and cumin. Cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the saucepan and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the onions are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Serve over rice or with flatbread.
